descriptions: You can download a trial version of this app to try it for 30 minutes for free.
You won’t be charged anything when this free trial ends. You can’t make in-app purchases or use add-on content during this free trial, but you’ll keep any achievements you earn.

display_long_description:
Kinneta for Cycling and Running Fitness Machines is now in Full Access! 

YOUR VR FITNESS ADVENTURE AWAITS. We designed this app with leading fitness company Woodway specifically for TREADMILLS and BIKES. Exercise one-on-one with top fitness trainers to a variety of music genres and teleport to breathtaking sites worldwide, from mountains to beaches. Alternatively, bring Kinneta’s pro trainers to your home as ultra-realistic holograms for a private class in passthrough. Your workouts will never be the same!

Hop on a treadmill or bike, calibrate, and exercise. Kinneta’s Motion Engine allows you to seamlessly work out in VR and is compatible with all bikes and treadmills. You’ll see your treadmill or bike in passthrough, making the experience safe and comfortable.

You’ll access a library with 70 bike and treadmill workouts, ranging from quick, easy warm-ups to intense, 40-minute challenges. 

For Quest 2, 3, and 3S. We recommend a non-fabric head strap, like Kiwi, for treadmill speeds higher than 6 MPH (10KM/H).
